messages:
Nora: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — need a tiny rubric for GTM + eng: when to recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private?
Diego: short version: Hosted = default trial/PLG; Dedicated = committed capacity & predictable perf; Private = compliance/air-gapped/KMS.
Maya: can we get 3 bullet signals for each so sales has handoff cues?
Aisha: yes, copyable checklist below:
Hosted: trial users, variable QPS, no residency/KMS asks
Dedicated: steady high QPS, willing to commit spend, asks for latency SLAs
Private: procurement/legal require VPC or on-prem, audit/KMS constraints
Diego: ops note: prioritize infra work 1) Hosted reliability & cost, 2) Dedicated packing/batching & kernel wins, 3) Private packaging & automation.
Nora: can leadership add a one-line positioning quote for the deck vs marketplaces/cloud infra?
Aisha: draft: "Redwood makes serving predictable and economical — we remove inference ops so product teams ship faster across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private."
ops-bot: recording uploaded: https://redwood.slack/meeting-recordings/all-hands-2172220001 (auto-post)
Maya: perfect, I'll add this to the GTM one-pager and slide. thanks! :thumbsup:
Nora: thanks team, will announce updated playbook once live.
